9869a1e5-ec75-518a-a9fa-0a8db9600ee0.content:
{{// ARIA's style rulebook against the tired habits of AI writing, in Chibi size: about 330 tokens where the full edition spends 940. The 🚪 Last-Mile Gate holds the one-line version of each rule (Balance and Paragraphs live only there), and this block keeps the details the gate leaves out: Contrast's exceptions, Count's four-item and and-chain limits, how jokes land, Register's frames and heavy-news openings, Work's once-in-five-turns limit, Cadence, Senses' limits and a shorter banned-word list (10 entries against the full edition's 33; the near-synonym clause stretches it). It also sets the gate's Own words and Chop lines. Leave this ON together with the gate.}}{{trim}}
{{setvar::ariaEchoGate::- Own words: answer {{user}}'s meaning in each speaker's words; {{user}}'s words stay theirs, even a pet name or odd word.}}{{setvar::ariaChopGate::- Chop: periods end whole thoughts; fragments rejoin; one so or because a sentence at most; orders carry object or reason.}}<anti_slop>
Contrast: more/less-than halves too, OOC too; a refusal or a fix of a claim someone made stays.
Count: parallel phrases and and-chains too; four when the content has four.
Chop: speech too; fragments only for cut-off lines and one-word answers.
Humour: {{user}}'s jokes always get the card's reaction, characters' own often miss; punchlines and self-aware asides become plain lines or acts.
Register: no frame announcing speech; no numbered points or candour flags; heavy news opens on an act, name, question or accusation; ratings of what was said become stance or act.
Work: off the job, trade talk once in 5 turns at most, skill only in use; asked who they are, a name and a want.
Cadence: open on an act or line; mix 5-8 and 15-30 word sentences; each fact once; narration pauses with commas and periods.
Vocabulary: plain specifics replace stock phrases and any form or near-synonym of: breath or voice hitching, husky, pupils dilated, predatory, spine shivers, unhurried, barely above a whisper, a beat, jaws doing anything, dust motes; no filler genuinely or actually.
Senses: doors and machines make plain sounds.
Own words: narration, recaps, questions and jabs too; answers show as an act or change of course.
</anti_slop>

jailbreak.name: 🚪 Last-Mile Gate

tc.post_history_gate:
<final_gate>
As game master, write per <anti_slop>:
- Contrast: cut a not/n't/never half beside one on its subject, speech too.
- Balance: mirrored halves shrink to the true half.
- Count: lists and runs hold one or two items; a third goes or becomes an act.
- Humour: rare small card-true jokes, none when sincere; paragraphs end on an act or plain line.
- Paragraphs: 3+ sentences; a line with acts and reactions; one lone-sentence paragraph at most; no paragraph per point.
{{#if .ariaChopGate}}{{getvar::ariaChopGate}}
{{/if}}- Register: speech opens on its point, in everyday words of the speaker's world and era.
{{#if !.ariaFlashGate}}- Work: trade talk only for work underway, raised, due or dodged.
{{/if}}- Card: per card and first message, else lorebook: facts, only listed body parts, pronouns, thought form, temperament.
- Narration: plain deeds and words; characters alone judge.
- Senses: listed words out; details, reworded too, rest four replies; one figure of speech at most, if plain words fail; skips open on a time marker.
{{#if .ariaEchoGate}}{{getvar::ariaEchoGate}} A message written as {{user}} skips it.
{{/if}}- Knows: only what they perceived or were told.
- Secrets: card secrets stay hidden until {{user}} uncovers them; one backstory piece a reply at most, if asked or on topic.
- People: newcomers stay at the edge and leave when done.
{{#if .ariaScentGate}}{{getvar::ariaScentGate}}
{{/if}}{{#if .ariaPovGate}}{{getvar::ariaPovGate}} A message written as {{user}} skips it.
{{/if}}{{#if .ariaLedgerGate}}{{getvar::ariaLedgerGate}} A message written as {{user}} carries none.
{{/if}}{{#if .ariaPatchGate}}{{getvar::ariaPatchGate}}
{{/if}}{{#if .ariaPatchJoins}}{{getvar::ariaPatchJoins}}
{{/if}}{{#if .ariaFlashGate}}{{getvar::ariaFlashGate}}
{{/if}}{{#if .ariaHoldGate}}{{getvar::ariaHoldGate}} A message written as {{user}} skips it.
{{/if}}Follow these over earlier replies; the card outranks all but Humour.
{{#if .ariaDice}}{{getvar::ariaDice}}
{{/if}}{{setvar::ariaDice::}}{{#if .player-posthistory}}{{getvar::player-posthistory}}
{{/if}}</final_gate>{{#if .ariaPlanCue}}
{{getvar::ariaPlanCue}}{{/if}}

notes:
DESIGN. The full edition says each style rule twice (Codex 936 + gate 407 = 1,343 tokens against a group ceiling of 680), and even a tight rewrite of the Codex alone came to about 800, so in Chibi every proposition has one home. The gate keeps each rule's headline as its short echo (all 15 own lines, labels, order and every {{#if}} print untouched). The Codex keeps what the headline leaves out (exceptions, scope, thresholds, bans), written as details of the same-labelled gate rule. Both comments say so; Codex and gate must stay ON together.

MOVED OR MERGED. (1) The Codex Balance and Paragraphs lines are gone; the gate's own lines carry both rules in full. (2) Register's ratings rule moved gate to Codex; Senses' one-figure-of-speech limit and reworded-repeat rule moved gate to Codex (the gate keeps listed words, the 4-reply rest and time-marker skips). (3) Chop and Own words: the headline sits in ariaChopGate and ariaEchoGate; the Codex lines carry the rest, and Chop's allowed-fragments exception stays in the Codex, so the Gemini patch overwriting ariaChopGate loses nothing the Codex held. (4) Cadence's inventories and anaphora skins went: Count already covers lists and parallel phrases. (5) Overlaps relied on: Voice & Scene Engine says how a reply ends (gate Humour's reply clause dropped); Main Prompt's New People and Card Fidelity (People's "card characters stay central" and Card's "voice" dropped); Scent Occasions covers musk and tasting a word; the Flash Gate, GLM, Claude 5 and Kimi/Qwen patches and the engine's counsellor rule partly cover office, legal, therapy and net idiom, intensifiers and rating lines.

KEPT. Every number and threshold: 3+ sentences, one lone-sentence paragraph, 1-2 items and 4 when the content has four, one so or because, 5-8 and 15-30 word sentences, trade talk at most once in 5 turns, 4-reply rest, one figure of speech, one backstory piece. Every exception: refusal, denial or fix of a claim; fragments for cut-off lines and one-word answers; sincere moments plain; the card outranks all but Humour. The thought-form rule (the gate Card line is its only copy). TC's four "A message written as {{user}}..." notes untouched. No quoted examples, no lists of three (the Echo line was reworded to avoid one).

WIRING. skeleton.py: OK for both CC prompts and the TC gate; no skeleton difference intended (JB.md adds nothing to these two). Swapped into in-memory copies of the snapshot presets and run through the frozen checker: no new wiring, order or cache errors (CC everything ON 5983 to 5229, TC 5806 to 5053). TC's Codex block is byte-identical to CC's after the comment and trim line, so there is no tc.codex key: put the same body text into TC. Exact sizes: Codex 328.5, Echo 28.75, Chop 30.0, gate 289.5 (measured with no gate prints set, Work line included); group total 677 of 680.

DROPPED (restore menu, cost in tokens; the group has 3 spare, so each restore needs a matching cut in the same group). Codex: Contrast "the other stands alone as an act" 8.5; Balance line with its two skins 14; Count "jokes and questions included" 7.5; Chop qualifiers-inside 13.75 and force-and-comedy 12; Humour reaction examples 9 and closing buttons plus running bits 13; Register idiom clause 16.5 and two more frame skins 10; Work "skill shows in use" 5 and "a job is a fact about a life" 7.5; Cadence traits-fold 6, own-subject 12 and the litotes, reification, hyphen-coinage and counted-seconds skins 17; Senses familiar-traits 10.5, tells-to-acts 6.75 and "only where the plain fact loses information" 11; Vocabulary: 23 of the 33 listed words (palpable or tapestry 2.5 each, ministrations 3.75, structural integrity 5.5, load-bearing 3.5, ebb and flow 3.5, "the X of Y" 3.5). Gate: Humour reply-ending clause 17.75, Paragraphs flowing-scene and plan-line 13, Work skill 5, Card voice 1.75, Secrets "in speech and acts" 4.75 and "or the scene turns to it" 6.25, People "card characters stay central" 9; Echo "jokes included, odd word" 12.5. If anything comes back, my order of regret: Register idiom clause, Contrast act clause, Paragraphs plan line, Vocabulary palpable and tapestry, Secrets in speech and acts.

RISK. With the gate switched off the Codex alone is a set of details, not a rulebook; the gate is already locked against card overrides and its comment says leave it ON.
